HTML 转纯文本——按阅读顺序抽取，不上传HTML to plain text offline — in reading order

把一封邮件、一篇文档站页面或一段富文本变成纯文本，难点不是去标签，而是保住阅读顺序。这条路径先用 DOMParser 解析，再递归遍历：`script` / `style` / `noscript` 整块丢弃，`<br>` 转换行，图片按 `alt` 写成 `[Image: …]`，有序列表按位置编号并尊重 `start`，嵌套列表每层缩进两个空格，链接在文字后追加 ` [href]`（页内锚点与 `mailto:` 除外），表格的每个单元格后面跟一个制表符，而单元格之间的换行也会照抄进文本：紧凑排版的表格是一行一条记录，源码里换行排版的表格会一格一行。最后把三个以上连续换行压成两个。Turning an email, a docs page or a rich-text fragment into plain text is less about deleting tags than about preserving reading order. This route parses with DOMParser and walks the tree: `script` / `style` / `noscript` are dropped wholesale, `<br>` becomes a newline, images become `[Image: …]` from their `alt`, ordered lists are numbered by position and honour `start`, nested lists indent two spaces per level, links append ` [href]` after their text (in-page anchors and `mailto:` excluded), and each table cell is followed by a tab — newlines between cells in the source are copied into the text too, so a compact table gives one record per line while a source-formatted one gives one cell per line. Runs of three or more newlines collapse to two at the end.

会保留什么What carries over

  • 有序列表按实际位置编号，并尊重 `start`；嵌套层级用两空格缩进表示（最多 6 层）Ordered lists are numbered by position and honour `start`; nesting is shown with two spaces per level, capped at six
  • 链接保留 URL，写在链接文字之后；`#` 锚点与 `mailto:` 不追加Links keep their URL after the link text; `#` anchors and `mailto:` are not appended
  • 图片用 `alt` 写成 `[Image: alt]`，没有 alt 时写 `[Image]`Images become `[Image: alt]` from their alt text, or `[Image]` when there is none
  • 每个单元格后面都跟一个制表符；单元格之间没有换行的表格（例如本扩展自己生成的 HTML 表格）会一行一条记录，而源码里换行排版的表格（marked、美化过的 HTML）会让每格各占一行Every cell is followed by a tab; a table whose cells are not separated by newlines in the source (the HTML this extension itself writes) comes out one record per line, while a source-formatted table (marked, pretty-printed HTML) yields one cell per line
  • 复杂 HTML 的解析交给 DOMParser，实体、嵌套与畸形标记都不会让文本错位DOMParser handles the HTML, so entities, nesting and malformed markup do not shift the text

如实说明的限制What it does not do

  • 不执行 CSS：`display:none` 或隐藏区域里的文字仍会被抽取，判断“可见”不是这一层的职责CSS is not executed: text inside `display:none` or hidden regions is still extracted, because deciding what is visible is not this layer’s job
  • 表格只做制表符分隔，不做列对齐；合并单元格、列宽与表头语义都不会保留Tables get tabs, not alignment; merged cells, column widths and header semantics are not preserved
  • 列表只处理有序与无序两种：`type`（字母 / 罗马数字）与 `reversed` 被忽略，编号一律用十进制位置表示Only ordered and unordered lists are handled: `type` (letters, roman numerals) and `reversed` are ignored, and numbering is always decimal position
  • 版式、颜色、字号与图片像素全部丢失，产物是纯文本Layout, colour, font size and image pixels are all gone — the result is plain text
  • 脚本动态生成的内容不在 HTML 里，也就不会被抽出来Content generated by scripts is not in the HTML, so it cannot be extracted

实操提示Working with it

  • 适合做全文检索、给命令行工具喂输入，或把网页正文贴进邮件与工单Good for full-text search, feeding a command-line tool, or pasting a page’s body into an email or a ticket
  • 同一份 HTML 还能转 Markdown（保留结构）或 Word（保留可编辑段落）；纯文本这条只保留阅读顺序The same HTML can go to Markdown (structure kept) or Word (editable paragraphs); the plain-text route keeps only reading order

常见问题Questions people actually ask

列表编号为什么还在？Why are the list numbers still there?

编号不是文本节点，而是由 `<li>` 的位置生成的。这条路径按位置补上 `1.`、`2.`，并尊重 `<ol start>`；不补的话，一份编号步骤会变成一串没有顺序的句子。The numbers are not text nodes; they are generated from each `<li>`’s position. This route writes `1.`, `2.` from that position and honours `<ol start>`; without it, a numbered procedure would become a run of sentences with no order.

隐藏的文字也会被抽出来吗？Is hidden text extracted too?

会。这一层只按标签结构走，不读 CSS，也不判断元素是否被 `display:none` 隐藏；它回答的是“HTML 里写了什么”，不是“浏览器里看见什么”。Yes. This layer walks the tag structure without reading CSS or checking `display:none`; it answers “what the HTML says”, not “what the browser shows”.

图片为什么变成 [Image]？Why do images become [Image]?

纯文本存不下图片。有 `alt` 时写成 `[Image: alt]`，没有时写 `[Image]`；这是提醒读者原位置有一张图，而不是把图片内容转成文字。Plain text cannot hold an image. With alt text it becomes `[Image: alt]`, without it `[Image]`; the marker tells the reader an image sits there, rather than transcribing its content.

不需要账号，也不需要联网：装好扩展后点图标，在新标签页里打开工作台，文件从磁盘直接选。No account and no network: install the extension, click its icon, and the workbench opens in a new tab reading straight off your disk.
